summary: Converts HSV-encoded TOP image data to RGB, with behavior primarily governed by Common TOP parameters.
common_gotchas: Feed HSV-encoded image data, not ordinary RGB, or the conversion result will be meaningless.
The official page is sparse, so keep behavior notes tied to the operator name and common TOP controls.
Channel Mask can make conversion look incomplete.
Low-precision formats can clip or quantize converted color values.
key_concepts: HSV to RGB TOP converts HSV-encoded image data into RGB image data.
The official page has no unique operator-specific parameter rows under its operator page.
The operator has one TOP input and common TOP output controls.
Common output resolution, channel mask, and pixel format settings can affect visible conversion results.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
